claims.claim: Anthropic told investors Q3 2026 revenue was $16.8B, up from $11.6B in Q2 and $4.7B in Q1, per two investor-day attendees cited by Reuters.
Anthropic told the investor-day group it was profitable on an adjusted basis in the third quarter of 2026.
Reuters attributes the $110B year-end run rate to estimates by analysts who met executives, not to company guidance.
Anthropic did not discuss its September annualized revenue rate or a full-year outlook at the investor presentation, per The Information.
Anthropic's adjusted operating margin was about 11% (Bloomberg: 11%+ for Q3; The Information: 11% for the year through Q3), excluding stock-based compensation.
Anthropic's adjusted gross margin was 85% in Q3 2026; its gross margin above 80% excludes training costs and revenue shared with distribution partners.
Anthropic generated $1.70 in revenue for every dollar spent on compute in Q3 2026 and was cash-flow positive, per the FT.
Per Reuters' reading of the draft prospectus, Anthropic's 2025 revenue was $4.59B, operating expenses $12.65B, compute and infrastructure $7.33B, and operating loss $8.06B (2024: $2.98B).
Anthropic's 2025 net loss was about $42B, of which about $34B was a non-cash charge on financing that could convert into shares.

Anthropic disclosed at least $518B of compute and infrastructure obligations, about 80% non-cancellable, including about $161.2B of Broadcom-related equipment leases, $111.1B with Google, $110B with Amazon, up to $84.5B with SpaceXAI and $31.4B with Microsoft.
Anthropic pays SpaceX $1.25B per month until May 2029 for compute capacity, with discounted payments during the ramp.
Anthropic stated run-rate revenue of $14B on 12 Feb 2026, over $30B in April 2026 and over $47B in early May 2026.
Anthropic's run-rate revenue surpassed $65B at the end of July 2026, per Bloomberg.
Marketplace sales via Amazon and Google were $2.16B, 47% of 2025 revenue, booked gross, with about $351M of partner fees recorded in sales, marketing and partnerships expense.
Two customers accounted for nearly one-quarter of Anthropic's 2025 revenue, per the draft prospectus as reported.
Anthropic's May 2026 projections showed a Q2 operating profit figure of $559M on $10.9B revenue that includes model training costs but excludes stock-based compensation.
Anthropic expected to spend 56 cents on compute per revenue dollar in Q2 2026, down from 71 cents in Q1, and told investors it likely won't be profitable for the whole year.
Distillation accounted for 5 to 7 percent of Anthropic's revenue and was expected to decline.
SemiAnalysis estimated Anthropic's annualized revenue at about $74B, and Anthropic is reportedly expected to end 2026 below $100B.
The NYT reported Anthropic would exceed $100B in annualized revenue; Gulf News renders this as by end-2026 while an Axios relay says it is now pacing above $100B.

Regulation S-K Item 10(e) requires the most directly comparable GAAP measure with equal or greater prominence and a reconciliation, and bars liquidity measures that exclude charges requiring cash settlement.
SEC C&DI 100.01 says excluding normal, recurring, cash operating expenses can make a non-GAAP measure misleading; C&DI 100.04 flags individually tailored accounting.
Bloomberg reported Anthropic could start marketing shares the week of 9 November with trading before Thanksgiving.
Claude Code weekly limits fell about 17% net from 14 September 2026 as a temporary 50% boost expired and standard limits rose 25%.
Anthropic is seeking an IPO valuation of more than $2 trillion versus its $965B Series H post-money valuation.
Q3 2026 revenue of $16.8B annualizes to $67.2B.
Q3 2026 revenue grew about 45% quarter on quarter.
